videos.script: Ana writes down what she believes about the shop's orders. Six beliefs, as six tests. {{beliefs}} Two fail, by thousands. {{fail}} One was wrong about the shops. A till sells to whoever walks in, and most people give no name. {{tills}} One was wrong about the grain. An order has many lines. {{grain}} Narrowed, the first still fails, seven times. Seven customers who asked to be forgotten. {{erased}} A failing test stops everything built after it. So the seven become a warning, not an error. {{warn}} Then a test of her own catches the incremental table drifting, eleven days of it. {{drift}} And the project learns what its tables mean, and who reads them in the morning.
